name: excalisheet
description: Turn technical content and docs into simple Excalidraw diagrams, cheat sheets, and social banners.

interface.longDescription: Turn technical posts, notes, concepts, public docs pages, terms, and images into simple editable Excalidraw diagrams, one-page cheat sheets, or clean landscape social banners. Excalisheet removes unnecessary detail and prioritizes clarity.
defaultPrompt: Turn this technical post into a simple cheat sheet.
Make a diagram explaining KV cache.
Make an X banner from this technical content.

prompts: Make a diagram explaining KV cache.
Turn this technical explanation into a one-page cheat sheet: A model receives tokens, processes the input, and generates output tokens one at a time.
Turn this docs page into a cheat sheet: https://docs.weaveos.com/router/overview
Make an X banner from this technical content using the terms model routing, cost, and speed.

publication.release_notes: Adds Banner mode alongside Diagram and Cheat sheet modes. Banner mode creates simple landscape social visuals from posts, docs URLs, terms, and images.
